summary: Iteration 3 — Resume upload fix verification. NEW resume regression suite (test_resume_upload.py, parametrized preview+prod, 14 tests): PREVIEW 7/7 pass — POST /candidate/resume real .docx -> 200 (file_name/ext/size correct, text field NOT leaked), .txt -> 415 'Unsupported file type', 6MB pdf -> 413 'too large', fake pdf bytes -> 400 'not a valid PDF', GET /candidate/resume polls to analysis completed with score (42), POST reanalyze -> {'status':'processing'}, DELETE -> ok and GET confirms resume gone. PROD (matchjob-india.emergent.host): happy path 5/7 passes (docx 200, analysis completes, reanalyze, delete) BUT prod is running STALE code — .txt returns 400 (old msg 'Unsupported file type. Allowed: pdf, doc, docx') instead of 415, and 6MB pdf returns 400 ('File too large. Max 5 MB') instead of 413. Fake-pdf 400 passes because old code also returned 400 for it. CRITICAL: prod deployment must be redeployed with current code. Full prior regression suite re-run: 63/63 pass (initial 429s were login rate-limit 10/300s sliding window from repeated test logins — resolved after window reset, not a real regression). One stale test updated: test_backend.py::TestFileValidation::test_upload_txt_rejected now expects 415 (matches new contract). FRONTEND web (390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=preview): login candidate -> /home, home sections render (Recommended/match/Recent), home-resume-button -> /resume, upload small .docx via DocumentPicker (resume-upload-button / resume-replace-button) -> success toast 'Resume uploaded. AI analysis started.' (data-testid=toast-message; note toast auto-dismisses after 2.8s), file card shows name 'test_resume.docx' + size '1 KB', analysis completes within ~15s showing score card 44/100 (resume-score-value), strengths list (resume-strengths) and suggestions list (resume-suggestions) visible. Regression smoke: Jobs tab loads with 6 job cards, Applications tab loads, Profile -> logout -> /login, re-login works. No red screens, no console errors. SECRETS CHECK PASS: RESUME_UPLOAD_DEBUG lines in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log contain only user id, kind, filename, ext, byte count, resume id, text_len, score — zero lines match bearer|token|password|authorization|eyJ. Client-side console RESUME_UPLOAD_DEBUG shows name/type/url only, no auth header. Native (Android) uploadAsync path could not be executed here (web preview only) — code reviewed in src/api.ts: uses expo-file-system/legacy uploadAsync MULTIPART with Bearer header, maps non-2xx via errMessage, network errors -> 'Unable to connect...'.

critical.issue: PROD deployment is stale — returns OLD error contract: .txt -> 400 (expected 415) with old message 'Unsupported file type. Allowed: pdf, doc, docx'; 6MB pdf -> 400 (expected 413) with old message 'File too large. Max 5 MB'. Preview returns correct 415/413/400. Client STATUS_MSG mappings for 413/415 will never fire against prod until it is redeployed. Happy path (docx 200, analysis, reanalyze, delete) works on prod.

minor.issue: Native uploadAsync client call has no explicit timeout (120s timeout only applies to the web fetch path in api()); a hung OkHttp upload could wait on OS defaults. Cosmetic — backend handles the file fine.

react_native_issues.issue: Carryover from iterations 1-2 (not re-verified this round, presumably still present): 'shadow*' style props deprecated warnings across screens. Migrate to unified boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx and screen StyleSheet blocks.

action_items: CRITICAL: Redeploy production backend (matchjob-india.emergent.host) — it is running pre-fix code (old 400-only error contract). Verify after deploy: txt -> 415, >5MB -> 413, fake pdf -> 400.

Physical Android verification still required by user (cannot be done here): after pulling latest code run `yarn install` (expo-file-system dependency) then rebuild in Android Studio and upload a real .docx/pdf on device.
Carryover: fix uncontrolled->controlled TextInput warning on register screen (initialize optional fields to '') — iteration 2 item, not retested this round.
Optional: add an explicit timeout/cancellation around FileSystem.uploadAsync in src/api.ts for parity with the 120s web upload timeout.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts uploadFile correctly branches Platform.OS !== 'web' -> FileSystem.uploadAsync (OkHttp, reads file from disk) vs web -> fetch+FormData; Authorization header attached on both paths; non-2xx parsed via shared errMessage so 413/415 map to friendly messages.

Backend store_file validation order is correct: extension allowlist (415) -> empty file (400) -> size cap (413) -> magic bytes (400). RESUME_UPLOAD_DEBUG logs are free of secrets/PII beyond user id and filename.

Login rate limiter (10/300s sliding window per IP, in-memory) aggressively throttles automated suites — future test runs should reuse session tokens or space suites by >300s. In-memory limiter resets on backend restart (acceptable at this scale, noted).

rca_of_issue: Original bug: Android fetch+FormData cannot stream content:// cache URIs -> 'Unable to connect'. Fix (native uploadAsync via expo-file-system/legacy) verified by code review + web path verified end-to-end; native path untestable in this environment. NEW issue found this iteration: prod deployment never received the fix — error responses on prod use old codes/messages while preview is correct. Repro: curl -F file=@x.txt https://matchjob-india.emergent.host/api/candidate/resume -> 400 (should be 415); same against preview -> 415. Mitigation: redeploy prod from current main.
